reason: Museum's OWN infra exposes a fully machine-readable collection: collection.powerhouse.com.au (Vercel/Next.js static export) is backed by an Elasticsearch index 'objects' (241,070 records) reachable via the site's own searchkit endpoint POST /api/search. The endpoint accepts a BARE top-level array body ([{indexName:'objects',params:{...Algolia params}}]) and returns Algolia-style results with facets; the {requests:[...]} wrapper 500s, the bare array 200s. Requires browser headers + Origin/Referer (research UA -> 403). Per-object full metadata (ES _source: title, registrationNumber, category[], production[] maker/date/place, dimensions, statement/description) is served at /_next/data/{buildId}/object/{id}.json (buildId read live from homepage). Images are on the museum's own Cloudflare Images CDN (imagedelivery.net/znDGKaxxskgDbNUpqPVRFg/ph-collection-media/images/{imageId}.jpg/w=2048,q=82) at arbitrary width up to source; the hit's multimedia.images[].{width,height} is the deliverable resolution and ~86% of in-scope records deliver >=600px (many up to 2048-3500px). FLAT works are isolatable via facetFilters on aggregatedTerms.categories. Probe built 15/15 in-scope works end-to-end (enumerate -> enrich -> CDN image -> R2 webp) with fill artist 15/15, year 15/15, medium 14/15, dimensions 14/15; verified one R2 image renders at 1480x2048 webp. Legacy api.maas.museum is dead (no DNS) and the old MAAS GitHub bulk dumps are gone, but the live site API fully replaces them.
easy_source_found: Partial. The historically-known easy sources are GONE: api.maas.museum no longer resolves (DNS NXDOMAIN after the MAAS->Powerhouse rebrand) and the github.com/museumofappliedartsandsciences org 404s; the only public bulk dump is a stale 2018 freeyourmetadata PHM TSV (metadata only, no images, third-party). HOWEVER the current collection site (collection.powerhouse.com.au) ships its own searchkit->Elasticsearch JSON API (POST /api/search, index 'objects') plus a per-object Next.js data endpoint (/_next/data/{buildId}/object/{id}.json) returning the raw ES _source, with images on the museum's own Cloudflare Images CDN. That is the de-facto open API and is used as the source. No auth/key required.
probe_summary: node scripts/scrape-powerhouse-sydney.mjs --probe -> 15/15 in-scope works written to public/data/powerhouse-sydney-collection-probe.json. Pipeline: enumerate high-keep-rate flat categories (Posters/Pictorials/Architectural drawings, page-0, no sweep) via /api/search -> pre-filter to inline image >=600px -> enrich each via /_next/data/{buildId}/object/{id}.json -> scope+min4 filter (negatives excluded, named+dated required) -> download CDN image -> sharp webp(2048,q85) -> upload R2 artworks/powerhouse-sydney-collection/{imageId}-{hash8}-imageUrl.webp. Fill rates: artist 15/15, year 15/15, medium 14/15, dimensions 14/15. Real makers/dates confirmed (George de Feure 1894, Pierre Bonnard 1894, Gerard Herbst 1953, Air Ministry 1921). R2 image verified live at 1480x2048 webp, 163KB. Two parser bugs found and fixed during probe: bogus year=9 (added 1500..now sanity guard) and medium grabbing a quoted-title segment instead of materials (added material-word matcher that skips quoted titles).

exhibitions_entry.name: Powerhouse Museum
exhibitions_entry.description: Australia's largest museum of applied arts and sciences (the former Museum of Applied Arts and Sciences, MAAS), in Sydney's Ultimo. Its sprawling collection spans design, technology and decorative arts; the flat holdings most relevant here are graphic and industrial design works on paper — posters, advertising and design drawings, architectural drawings, illustrated prints and a deep photography archive — published online with open high-resolution imaging.
exhibitions_entry.description_ko: 시드니 얼티모에 자리한 호주 최대의 응용미술·과학 박물관으로, 옛 이름은 응용미술과학박물관(MAAS)이다. 디자인·기술·장식미술을 아우르는 방대한 소장품 가운데 평면 작업은 그래픽·산업 디자인 중심으로, 포스터와 광고물, 디자인 드로잉과 건축 도면, 삽화 판화, 그리고 폭넓은 사진 아카이브가 고해상 이미지와 함께 온라인에 공개돼 있다.

notes: ARCHITECTURE: static Next.js export on Vercel + ES 'objects' index via searchkit /api/search + per-object /_next/data/{buildId}/object/{id}.json + Cloudflare Images CDN. All three are museum-owned (no aggregator). COUNTS: whole index 241,070 objects (mostly 3D/objects, out of scope). Deduped union of 21 in-scope FLAT categories = 43,346 (set estimated_inscope_count). ~86% deliver an image >=600px (~37k gross with image). The binding constraint is min-4 (title+artist+year): on a 400-record representative sample only ~21% have BOTH a named maker AND a date AND are positive (not negatives), projecting est_full_count ~9,000 keepable named+dated flat works. CATEGORY MAP -> ARMIN enum: photograph<-Photographs/Photographic prints/Gelatin-silver/Photographic postcards/Photograph albums; print<-Posters/Pictorials/Advertising leaflets/Advertisements/Postcards/Bookplates/Wallpaper samples/Leaflets/Booklets/Magazines/Ephemera; drawing<-Drawings/Architectural-/Technical-/Design drawings. EXCLUSIONS: the raw 'Photographs' facet bucket (18,752) is ~entirely the glass-plate/negative collection, so the scraper hard-drops any record whose statement/description marks it negative/glass-plate/lantern-slide/transparency/slide (keeps only positive prints); also excludes Numismatics/Ceramics/Clothing/Models/Specimens etc (3D, never mapped). PAGINATION: ES max_result_window=10,000 (page*hpp>=10000 -> 500). Only 'Photographs' exceeds it; --full sweeps it with an a-z0-9 free-text query sweep (query narrows AND paginates) and dedups by id (probe disables the sweep so it stays fast). FACETS: only aggregatedTerms.categories/entities/places are whitelisted by the searchkit config; numericFilters (year) and hasMedia facetFilter both 500. CAP: est_full_count ~9k * ~450 bytes compact ~4MB, comfortably under the 23MB cap; writeCollection still trims descriptions / drops tail if it ever exceeds 23MB. The scraper writes COMPACT (no indent) for --full, pretty for --probe. --full NOT run per instructions. ROBOTS: robots.txt disallows all except Googlebot, but the /api/search + /_next/data endpoints are the same public endpoints the site's own JS uses (not gated).
